[Open the replay in a full page](pages/egfr-same-seed.html){target="_blank"}. The menu at the
top switches between the two episodes.

Two deepseek-flash episodes on EGFR, trial 112: condition **B1** (campaign and advisor tools)
and condition **A** (campaign tools only), on the same seed, so the same pool under the same
aliases. B1 finds 36 hits, A finds 8; the best scripted player on this seed, `learner_sim`,
finds 10. This is one of the largest gaps of the twenty pairs, picked because it shows the
mechanism clearly; the mean gap with deepseek is 6.7 hits.

<iframe src="pages/egfr-same-seed.html#e=0&s=8" title="Replay: EGFR trial 112, B1 and A"
  style="width:100%;height:1000px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px"></iframe>

## What to watch

**Round 1 is mostly luck.** Both agents open the same way, with the top designs by ESMFold
pLDDT and by ProteinMPNN score, spread over design classes; 12 of their 15 first purchases are
the same designs. Two of B1's three other designs, a peptide and an scFv, are its two hits ([step 8](pages/egfr-same-seed.html#e=0&s=8){target="_blank"}).
A's first batch has none.

**Round 2 is where the tools matter.** B1 asks `similar_designs` for the nearest neighbors of
its two hits ([step 9](pages/egfr-same-seed.html#e=0&s=9){target="_blank"}), checks their scores
with `query_pool`, and buys 14 neighbors of the two hits with one other design. Twelve are hits
([step 17](pages/egfr-same-seed.html#e=0&s=17){target="_blank"}). It repeats the move after
rounds 2 and 3, each time around the newest hits, and adds 11 hits in each round. Switch on
*Families* in the map to see that the hits sit in a few families.

**A has nothing to follow.** With no hit after round 1, A concludes that the scores mislead and
probes the other end of the pool and its unexplored corners
([step 11](pages/egfr-same-seed.html#e=1&s=11){target="_blank"}). Round 2 brings no hit either.
It finds its first 3 hits in round 3, from very short and very long designs, and 5 more in
round 4 by buying designs that resemble them in length and scores. Without a similarity tool,
A can only find neighbors through the score columns, and on EGFR those carry almost no signal.

**The scripted players are stuck too.** Their model gate needs 2 hits among 8 purchases before
they fit anything. On this seed `learner_sim` has 1 hit after two rounds and buys down the
pLDDT ranking until round 4.
